name: Inherited campaign audit
summary: When an agency takes over an account or prepares a campaign health review, the media or analytics lead gets an inventory of what is running against the client's plan: mismatched offers, disagreeing destination pages, missing measurement evidence, and an owner for each follow-up.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of agency work, and its own method for checking what is running in an ad account against the client's approved plan.
